summary: Fake libcuda driver-API shim (libfakecuda.so) builds and answers cuInit/cuDeviceGetCount/cuDeviceGet/cuDeviceGetAttribute and 60+ other driver calls, but real NCCL cannot complete ncclCommInitRank through it: cudart's initOnceFunc calls cuGetExportTable with two fixed UUIDs and requires a real opaque export table. Static-cudart (pip wheel) and a from-source NCCL v2.32.3-1 built against DYNAMIC cudart (DT_NEEDED libcudart.so.13) both fail identically at that call. Acceptance #3 (no real driver loaded) was never relaxed; no partial PASS claimed.

nccl_build.result: build/lib/libnccl.so.2.32.3 with DT_NEEDED libcudart.so.13 (dynamic cudart); CPU-only build, no GPU time used
nccl_build.note: NCCL's src/Makefile defaults CUDARTLIB=cudart_static; CUDARTLIB=cudart is required for the dynamic path. libcudacxx headers were taken from the pip nvidia/cuda_cccl package via a cccl symlink in the sysroot.

acceptance.1_dlopen_real_nccl_single_rank_init: FAIL (see output.log probes A and B)
acceptance.3_no_real_driver_loaded: HOLDS (shim interposes dlopen for libcuda.so; /proc maps contain only libfakecuda.so)
acceptance.4_negative_control_no_shim: PASS (output.log: without the shim and with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' the binary fails to init; with the real GPU visible it succeeds with 1 device)

cpu_runs.result: probe A FAIL, probe B FAIL, negative controls as expected

option_a_3alt.3-alt-iii: HOLDS: real handle opened with the real dlopen (dlvsym RTLD_NEXT), interception not recursed (AUDIT real-driver-handle open=OK)
option_a_3alt.3-alt-ii: HOLDS: GPUSIM_REAL_EXPORT_TABLE=0 -> the export-table error returns ('named symbol not found'), so the forwarding is load-bearing
option_a_3alt.3-alt-i: FAILS: after the real handshake, shim audit shows 0 calls for cuDeviceGetAttribute/PCIBusId/Name/Uuid/TotalMem/CtxCreate/MemAlloc*/MemHostRegister/Memcpy*/LaunchKernel -- every device call is served by the REAL driver through the table; NCCL then fails with 'initialization error' (no real device). The export table carries the whole driver vtable, not an isolated handshake.

dynamic_cudart_probe.detail: from-source NCCL v2.32.3-1 built with CUDARTLIB=cudart (DT_NEEDED libcudart.so.13, 0 libcudart_static symbols, 72 undefined cuda* symbols) still calls cuGetExportTable and fails identically.
